title: Local player ship template
description:
AGENTS: before modifying this schema, read AGENTS.md at the repository root.

Defines the player-controlled ship entity type. Per ADR-0038, templates are loaded and validated independently of the world definition. All visual content (meshes, materials) comes from glTF files per ADR-0019.

mesh.description: Mesh geometry loaded from glTF file. Required; missing glTF is a hard error (ADR-0013).

path.description: Path to glTF file (e.g., assets/glTF/ships/fighter.glb). Required; missing file is a hard error.

cameras.description: Camera definitions for cockpit and chase views. Both are required and spawn as child entities.

cockpit.description: Cockpit camera position relative to ship center (metres). Right-handed coordinates: +Y up, -Z forward per ADR-0006.

chase.description: Chase camera position relative to ship center (metres). Right-handed coordinates: +Y up, -Z forward per ADR-0006.
